findings.summary: Foresight Institute overview and organizational structure
findings.detail: Foresight Institute (EIN 77-0119168) is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit founded in 1986 by Christine Peterson, K. Eric Drexler, and James C. Bennett. Based in San Francisco. Originally focused on nanotechnology, now covers AI safety, biotech/longevity, molecular machines, crypto/blockchain. Current CEO Allison Duettmann. Board includes Sonia Arrison (also Thiel Foundation board), Dean Tribble (Agoric CEO), Brandon Goldman (Lionheart Ventures). Revenue grew from 137K (2010) to 9.4M (2024).

findings.summary: FBI ARMS Reach memo (EFTA00129096) identifies Draper as associate of Foresight Institute alongside Waitt and Lieber
findings.detail: FBI memo from WFO Squad CR05 (Transnational Organized Crime - Eastern Hemisphere) dated April 3 2025, prepared for ARMS Reach vetting of Tim Draper for proximity to POTUS. The memo specifically names Foresight Institute as the nexus connecting Draper, Waitt, and convicted Chinese spy Charles Lieber. This memo also links Draper to Masha Drokova (Putin's Kiss), QWave Capital, Runa Capital, and Frank Moyle Creer (alleged blackmail operations similar to Epstein).

findings.summary: Charles Lieber won 2001 Foresight Feynman Prize in Nanotechnology (Experiment) and co-chaired Foresight conference
findings.detail: Charles Lieber, Harvard chemistry professor later convicted of lying about ties to China's Thousand Talents Program and Wuhan University, received the prestigious 2001 Feynman Prize in Nanotechnology (Experiment category) from Foresight Institute. He also co-chaired Foresight's Conference on Advanced Nanotechnology and contributed to their Technology Roadmap for Productive Nanosystems, placing him deeply within the organization's leadership circles.

findings.summary: Ted Waitt funded Foresight nanotech roadmap with 250K and joined steering committee
findings.detail: Ted Waitt (Gateway Computers founder, Chairman of Avalon Capital Group) provided an initial 250K grant through the Waitt Family Foundation to fund Foresight's Technology Roadmap for Productive Nanosystems. Waitt also joined the steering committee overseeing this project, confirming his active engagement with Foresight leadership. This corroborates the FBI memo (EFTA00129096) identifying Waitt as a Foresight Institute member.

findings.summary: Tim Draper confirmed as Foresight associate by LittleSis; DFJ was corporate sponsor of Foresight Gatherings
findings.detail: LittleSis entity 225969 shows Tim Draper (entity 37259) has/had a position at Foresight Institute. Draper Fisher Jurvetson (DFJ) was a corporate sponsor of the Foresight Senior Associate Gathering. Steve Jurvetson (DFJ managing director) was a Senior Associate and keynote speaker at multiple Foresight Gatherings. This places the DFJ network deeply inside the Foresight orbit.

findings.summary: Peter Thiel fundraiser featured Foresight alongside 7 other orgs in Epstein corpus invitation (EFTA00752271)
findings.detail: December 7 2010 event at Palace of Fine Arts, San Francisco. Thiel Foundation showcased 8 nonprofits using technology to benefit humanity. This document was found in the Epstein files (EFTA00752271), meaning Epstein or someone in his circle was invited. Sonia Arrison serves on boards of both Thiel Foundation and Foresight Institute, providing the organizational link. Thiel Foundation also made a 100K grant to Foresight in 2013 per 990 records.

findings.summary: Foresight president J. Storrs Hall participated in AGI workshop that solicited Epstein funding (EFTA00775409)
findings.detail: Ben Goertzel emailed Jeffrey Epstein in June 2009 requesting funding for a Human-Level AGI Roadmapping workshop. Among confirmed participants was J. Storrs Hall of Foresight Institute, who became Foresight president in February 2009. The workshop was designed to create an AGI roadmap. Goertzel had an extensive funding relationship with Epstein for AGI research from 2012-2016 at minimum. This is the most direct Foresight-Epstein connection in the corpus.

findings.summary: LittleSis maps 19 relationships including PayPal mafia members Luke Nosek and Ed Boyden
findings.detail: LittleSis network map for Foresight Institute (entity 225969) reveals 19 relationships. Key people: Tim Draper (position), Luke Nosek (PayPal co-founder, position), Ed Boyden (MIT neuroscience, position), Todd Huffman (transhumanist, speaker/business), Brad Templeton (board), Glenn Reynolds (board of directors 1999-2007, then board of advisors 2007+), Anders Sandberg (business), Tristan Harris (Center for Humane Technology, business), Sasha Chislenko (Russian transhumanist, member). This maps significant Silicon Valley, PayPal mafia, and transhumanist network overlap.

findings.summary: 990 financials show rapid growth and funding from Thiel Foundation, Donors Trust, Goldman Sachs Philanthropy, Silicon Valley Community Foundation
findings.detail: Foresight Institute revenue surged from 137K (2010) to 9.4M (2024). Major funders include Silicon Valley Community Foundation (1.52M in 2022-2023), Legacy Global Foundation (500K in 2023), Founders Pledge (485K in 2021), Donors Trust (375K across 2020-2023, a Koch-linked donor-advised fund), Goldman Sachs Philanthropy Fund (175K across 2017-2022), Thiel Foundation (100K in 2013), and Vanguard/Fidelity/Schwab charitable funds. Foresight itself granted 1.1M to AI Objectives Institute (2021-2023), 60K to Agentic Future Foundation, and 44K to Transformative Futures.
